biggestGap: The engine's verified mate never reaches the board: src/game/index.ts is still the round-0 placeholder that hardcodes the 32-piece starting array and imports only START_FEN, so buildDemoGame() has zero call sites outside src/chess and king-surrender renders the opening position instead of the checkmate the brief demands.
critiqueDetail: The engine itself is genuinely correct and strong, and I verified it independently rather than trusting tools/perft.mjs. All 22 published perft values match exactly (startpos d5 4,865,609; kiwipete d4 4,085,603; position3 d5 674,624; position4 d4 422,333; position5 d4 2,103,487), and I reproduced them through a second, independent traversal built only on the public legalMoves/makeMove API — a different code path from the internal genPseudo+attacked perft. npx tsc --noEmit is clean; there is no Math.random/Date.now/performance.now in src/chess; search is byte-deterministic across repeated calls and across separate module instances, and two captures of the shot are byte-identical (md5 1b42ea28c770a67c06bb0eec3d1852e5). Strength is real, not claimed: 20-0 vs a random mover and 20-0 vs a greedy material bot, ~495k nodes/sec reaching depth 7-16, 14/18 on a standard WAC tactical suite, and every mate distance it reports matched my own brute-force mate solver exactly (including a KPK mate-in-5 it found optimally). All three demo lines replay move-by-move through the generator to a REAL checkmate — final position in check with exactly 0 legal replies, FEN chain matching at every ply. The failure is integration, not chess: the blind pair makes it visible, since the film panel shows a board strewn with wreckage from many captures while our panel shows all 32 pieces still on their home squares, so the brief's hard criterion 'board position must validate as a legal checkmate' is unmet on screen even though the engine can prove that mate.
metrics: perft 22/22 exact (+16 trap positions, mirror-symmetry, bulk-vs-full all OK); tsc clean; 20-0 vs random, 20-0 vs greedy; 494,965 nodes/sec; WAC 14/18; mate distances match brute force; 3/3 demo lines replay to real mate (0 legal replies); search + capture byte-deterministic; render meanSaturation 0.333 vs ref 0.455 (delta -0.123), meanLitHueDeg 8.2 vs ref 203 (delta -194.8), coolFraction 0.230 vs 0.596, detailTotal 0.0214 vs 0.0077
